description: This file defines an abstract class 'SearchableBaseNoteFragment' which extends 'BaseNoteFragment' and provides search functionality within note fragments for an Android application. It manages searching, highlighting, navigation between search results, and interaction with UI components like search view and floating action buttons.

classes.name: SearchableBaseNoteFragment
classes.description: An abstract class providing search capabilities in note fragments, including managing search queries, highlighting, and navigation between search results.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the color property using theme color when fragment starts.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Restores previous search query and current occurrence from saved state.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles UI visibility based on scroll and editing mode.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up search view, search result navigation, and query input handling with delay for performance.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current search query and occurrence index for state restoration.

methods.name: colorWithText
methods.description: Abstract method to highlight text matching the search query.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Abstract method to get the text layout for scrolling.

methods.name: getSearchNextButton
methods.description: Abstract method to get the 'next' search result button.

methods.name: getSearchPrevButton
methods.description: Abstract method to get the 'previous' search result button.

methods.name: getDirectEditingButton
methods.description: Abstract method to get the button for direct editing.

methods.name: getNormalEditButton
methods.description: Abstract method to get the button for normal editing.

methods.name: jumpToOccurrence
methods.description: Scrolls to the specific occurrence of the search term.

methods.name: indexOfNth
methods.description: Finds the index of the nth occurrence of a substring.

methods.name: countOccurrences
methods.description: Counts total number of occurrences of a search term in content.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding colors to UI components.
